reading.body:
Adobe reported $23.8 billion in annual revenue as of November 2025 and operates four commercial-use AI products across image, video, and audio generation, all trained on commercially safe data.

The company has moved AI from research into production across its core creative suite. Adobe Express AI and Adobe Firefly handle image generation. Premiere Pro AI extends this to video with generative tools for content extension and color matching. Adobe Podcast AI covers audio enhancement. Each product emphasizes commercial safety in training, a positioning that reflects Adobe's customer base of professional and enterprise users who require legal clarity on training data provenance.

This portfolio reveals how AI embeds into existing software infrastructure rather than replacing it. Adobe does not appear to offer foundation models or standalone inference services. Its AI features integrate into licensed design and video tools that already consume power and compute resources. For data center operators, this means AI workloads added to products customers already use, not new categories of demand.

The data does not cover compute spend, energy consumption, model size, or Adobe's infrastructure footprint. It does not reveal whether Adobe trains models in-house or relies on third parties. California legal exposure registers at 175 instances, but no specific disputes are documented here.

profile_text.body:
Adobe is a for-profit public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA. Its stock trades under the ticker ADBE, and its most recent annual filing (a 10-K) reported revenue of $23,769,000,000 for the period ending November 28, 2025. The company's website, focused on Adobe Express, describes it as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool intended to make content creation easy, with uses including social content, videos, and logos.

Adobe tracks several AI products across design, video, and audio categories. Adobe Express AI is described as a lightweight design tool with quick content creation capabilities and integration with Adobe Firefly, which is the company's image generation model. Both are characterized on the site as trained on commercially safe data. Premiere Pro AI covers professional video editing with features including generative extend and color match, also with a commercial-safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI provides audio enhancement including speech enhancement and microphone check, again with a commercial-safe training claim. The site additionally references an AI Assistant 2 within Adobe Express that allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while editing individual layers.

The held facts associate Adobe with 175 instances of legal exposure in California, though no specific cases are recorded in the available data. Adobe has a presence in the site's registry with CIK number 0000796343 on file.
